title: Embedding a single machine step
statement: Let $m\le k$, let $M$ have $m$ work tapes and state set $S$, and let $H$ have $k$ work tapes and state set $B$, both with Boolean tape alphabet. Let $\iota:S\to B$, and suppose configuration $c$ of $M$ is in state $q$. For any $b\in B$, assume that for every tuple of scanned input and work-tape symbols, the transition of $H$ at state $b$ is the padded, state-mapped action prescribed by $M$ at state $q$. Then one step of $H$ from the embedded configuration obtained by replacing its state with $b$ equals the embedding of the configuration reached by one step of $M$ from $c$.
